info.title: Traigent TVL Reactive Import Route
info.description: Import of a compiled TVL runtime contract; this contract models only the zero-native ReactiveImportReceipt response (TRAIG-101). The legacy native response and the request body are outside this contract. Portal catalog outside the optimization lint roots; the receipt schema stays closed and content-class checked.

post.summary: Import a compiled TVL runtime contract
post.description: Existing create-only import route (Backend: POST /production-requirements/tvl-import). This contract models only the reactive receipt response; the legacy native response and the import request body are outside this contract (no schema for them exists in this repo). A zero-native contract creates no production requirement and returns ReactiveImportReceipt: 201 first import, new digest with the same semantics, or policy edit; 200 exact replay; 409 genuine native conflict or environment rebinding. P-human only. Tenant and project come from the authenticated request context only. Dark behind PRODUCTION_REQUIREMENTS_ENABLED: while off the route answers the closed 404 reference_not_found. Every error body is the closed envelope tvl_reactive_common_schema.json#/definitions/Refusal except 429.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project id of the portal request; authorized against the authenticated tenant.

200.description: Exact replay of an existing import (receipt.created false). ReactiveImportReceipt.

400.description: invalid_request. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

401.description: unauthenticated. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

403.description: forbidden, fact_source_not_permitted. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

404.description: reference_not_found. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

409.description: requirement_exists, import_conflict, environment_rebinding. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

429.description: rate_limited. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait; the only rate-limit detail on the wire.

500.description: internal_error. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.

503.description: service_unavailable. Closed envelope; nothing is echoed.
